verdict.rationale: Ramp's product docs explicitly describe AI agents that 'scan transactions in real-time for anomalies,' handle fraud prevention, approve when safe and 'escalate when it's not,' with a hard guardrail that agents 'flag anything unclear or risky immediately for your review' and 'no money ever moves without human confirmation.' This is reinforced by dynamic approval routing, an audit log capturing every action, and webhooks explicitly named for 'anomaly conditions' notifications, giving both in-product automation and API-level event hooks for out-of-policy review workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of anomaly-flagging accuracy or false-positive rates, and no third-party case study explicitly confirming the anomaly-detection feature in production use.
